title: Lake District
concept: Several lake basins within a connected mainland, with reserved dry central routes and an outer land belt.
difference_from_base: A land map with multiple lake decisions and amphibious shortcuts; not an island map or one river crossing.
routes: Dry central axes and outer mainland belt guarantee land circulation; existing procedural ramp carving connects opening bases and resource sites.
economy: Automatic mirrored land economy, three fixed opening spots per side, general mex and geo controls.
known_weaknesses: Lakes can merge under large or crowded settings.
No guaranteed naval fleet network: this is a land profile.
core_wishes: Requires the unchanged _wildlands.py helper from TPL-highlands-1.
